NONCOMMERCIAL PORTFOLIO · FICTIONAL DATA ONLY

Explore the enquiry workflow.

Follow an idea from enquiry to classification, clarification, and a draft for human review. No reply is sent automatically.

Saved examples below are hand-authored fictional fixtures shipped with the app. Simulated results use local rules. Live-generated results use Gemini only when explicitly enabled, within shared daily and total limits.
